EVAL-F-03-S89.title: Define Facade Input/Output Schemas
EVAL-F-03-S89.description: Define and enforce structured request and response contracts for clinical trials search and provider detail lookup within the facade, ensuring consistent fields, formatting, and downstream compatibility.

EVAL-F-03-S90.title: Implement Facade Error Handling and Normalization
EVAL-F-03-S90.description: Implement standardized error handling within the facade to catch domain service failures, normalize error responses, and ensure safe, user-consumable outputs without leaking raw exceptions.

EVAL-F-03-S91.title: Integrate Pydantic Validation with Facade Inputs
EVAL-F-03-S91.description: Ensure facade methods accept and validate inputs using existing Pydantic tool models for clinical trials and provider queries, aligning tool_router validation with facade contracts.
